title: AI makes mistakes, just like humans | PhonePe CPTO Rahul Chari
description: In this episode of the ET AI Podcast, PhonePe CPTO Rahul Chari breaks down the realities, risks, and rewards of AI in fintech. He shares how PhonePe automates 90%+ of support queries, deploys on-premise open-source models for data privacy, and uses AI guardrails to fight fraud without sacrificing human explainability.

title: Nasdaq Climbs 0.6% as AI Stocks Roar Back After Last Week's Rout, Led by SpaceX Surge and Super Micro Rally
description: The Nasdaq rose as strong SpaceX and Super Micro results boosted AI stocks, though elevated interest rates, inflation concerns and upcoming earnings continued to weigh on investors.

title: Nvidia and Nokia Bring AI Into Live Mobile Networks
description: Nvidia and Nokia are moving their AI ambitions deeper into mobile networks.
